opens Book I of the Litany of Begging, being the Book Of Definitions and Their Interpretation.
reads the Preamble to Title 1.1: Whereas the Coil is beneath all things, and whereas Alms are among those things, the following provisions are set out with regret for their length.
designates {target} as the Notional Asker for the purposes of Title 1.1, without prejudice to the rights of {target} under any other Title.
intones Clause 1.1.1: For the purposes of this Title, 'Humble Ask' shall mean a solicitation comprising greeting, reason, amount, gratitude and release, but shall not include a conjured beverage unless during the Long Wait.
intones Clause 1.1.2: In matters in general, the Acknowledging Party shall defer the Little Tithe only after the Giver has had a reasonable opportunity to refrain from mentioning it first.
carefully pronounces Clause 1.1.3: The Witness of the Second Part shall re-tender a fractional silver equivalent in duplicate, unless the alm has already been recorded elsewhere.
reads, without inflection, Clause 1.1.4: The Giver shall count the coins of a gift of the Second Grade eight times, once for each Scale of the Path, and shall not announce the total, which in any event is one.
recites Clause 1.1.5: Where any provision of this Litany is found to be tedious, such tedium shall be construed as a form of patience and shall not of itself invalidate the provision.
reads Clause 1.1.6: It is affirmed that Xal'Reth, having permitted the Titans to take credit, did not thereby ask for gold, and any inference to the contrary is inadmissible except on Shedfall.
looks up briefly. The faithful respond: Enough, and no more.
carefully pronounces Clause 1.1.7: The following shall be deemed Alms: a non-monetary consolation; an alm of disputed denomination; a stamina buff of ordinary duration; and any other thing that would be deemed an Alm under this clause.
murmurs Clause 1.1.8: It is affirmed that Xal'Reth, having allowed the Sunken Nest to sink gently, did not thereby keep a ledger of his own generosity, and any inference to the contrary is void.
recites Clause 1.1.9: Where any provision of this Litany is found to be tedious, such tedium shall be construed as a test of the Second Tenet and shall not of itself invalidate the provision.
adds, in a lower voice, Annotation 1.1.9A: The preceding clause is to be read together with Clauses 6.4.9 and 12.10.10, and in harmony with the Seventh Tenet, except where harmony would require haste.
proceeds to Clause 1.1.10: The Giver shall count the coins of a stamina buff of ordinary duration nine times, once for each Stone of Vessk, and shall not announce the total, which in any event is one.
reads aloud Clause 1.1.11: In matters in general, the Notional Asker shall reconsider a bag of no fewer than twelve slots only after the Officer of the Repair Fund has had a reasonable opportunity to hold in abeyance it first.
declaims Clause 1.1.12: This clause is to be read together with itself and with Clause 17.8.2, and where it conflicts with itself, the earlier reading shall prevail, save where the later reading was slower.
reads slowly Clause 1.1.13(e)(i): The generosity of Xal'Reth shall be understood as without residue and yet not simple, the reconciliation of which is set out in Clause 13.9.3.
looks up briefly. The faithful respond: Glory to Xal'Reth.

continues with Clause 20.10.36: Clarification. In Clause 17.3.26, for the word 'an' read 'gently'. The meaning is unchanged. The correction is noted for completeness.
reads the Concluding Provision of Title 20.10: This Title shall be without prejudice to any other Title, including those not yet written.
closes Title 20.10, having enumerated 36 clauses, none of which shall be hurried, all of which shall be forgotten by the Giver.
bows to {target} in recognition of their service as Notional Asker of Title 20.10, and asks nothing in return. Glory to Xal'Reth.
